trigger: independent review by one background subagent on NordRouter/DeepSeek found a real defect in the first version of the closure repair

defect_found.summary: close_refused_processing closed the marker without repeating the message-eligibility gate the normal path applies
defect_found.why_it_matters: when a refusal fired before those checks (update bound, capture-context verification, continuation admission), the closure could record an unrelated message as the step's answer; the tester's own verify_reply_custody rejects exactly such observations, so the marker would be closed with evidence the codebase itself refuses
secondary: harness-integrity refusals were closed as ordinary product refusals, losing the distinction
only Refused was caught, so a closure error could replace the original refusal
the dedupe keyed on update_id while the normal path keys on message_id

changes: new close_eligible() mirrors the normal path gate: document, non-empty text, positive message id, chat id PEER and type private, sender id PEER and is_bot, no unsupported media key, message date inside the committed window, arrival before the window close, no observation yet for this update, text within budget, message budget not exhausted
reply target is re-derived from the protected send-ACK receipt rather than from the mutable run field, and must equal both the ACK message id and run['sent_message_id']
new committed_message_ids() collects message ids already committed by processed receipts, so the dedupe uses the receipt chain instead of the mutable run field
the closure call is wrapped so a closure failure can never mask the original refusal; the marker then simply stays open
repair.why_the_receipt_chain_for_dedupe: the normal path appends the message id to run['message_ids'] before a post-gate refusal can fire, so the mutable field cannot distinguish a fresh message from one already committed by an earlier update

verification.gate_unit_cases: 17 of 17 correct: valid reply accepted; missing or wrong reply_to, document, photo, wrong chat id, non-private chat, non-bot sender, wrong sender id, arrival after window, arrival without timestamp, message dated before send, already committed message id, existing observation, text over budget, missing ACK reference, ACK/sent-id disagreement all rejected
verification.end_to_end_positive: a post-gate refusal (repeated no-progress) on an eligible message still closes the chain with one observation and local_refusal_closure=true
verification.end_to_end_pre_gate: a pre-gate refusal (update bound) on an eligible message also closes, which is correct because the message itself passes the full gate
verification.negative_combination: a pre-gate refusal on a message that is not a reply is rejected by the gate, so the marker stays open - this is the case the review identified
verification.live_store: cursor_offsets OK at offset 261479702, zero inventory failures across all runs

acknowledgement: the first version of this repair was wrong in the way the review describes; the live store was never exposed to the defect because no refusal of that shape occurred while the earlier version was installed
